properties.site-address: Old Coal Yard, Northumberland Road, Tweedmouth
properties.notes: Former site of Tweedmouth goods yard, underused and currently largely vacant. An application for a residential development of 71 homes was permitted but has now lapsed (11/02030/OUT). Subsequent reserved matters application relating to this outline approval was withdrawn (15/01307/REM). The site is now identified as an allocation in the draft Local Plan (submitted May 2019) . Site offers opportunity for extensive redevelopment of railway land, adjacent to ECML, and yield considered to reflect urban location. Access limitations would need to be successfully overcome by a successful scheme.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
